messages:
priya_csm: Hey all 7— kicking off Vellum Labs onboarding thread. Main outcome: live pilot on Hosted Redwood with Dedicated fallback, customer demo by end of Q2. Quick check: proposed kickoff Thu Oct 3 @10am PT. Agenda: intros, outcomes & success criteria, access (SSO/API keys), data & connectors, infra sizing, enablement plan, risks. Can folks confirm?

maya_cs: Ican take enablement + post-pilot feedback capture. Thu 10/3 10a works.

vellum_pm: Works for our PM and tech lead. Were prepping a sanitized sample dataset and the schema. Will upload by Tue.

liam_se: Ill handle SSO + ingestion validation. Need the sample + a short list of core queries the app runs.

jonas_eng: Will scope Dedicated sizing and smoke tests. Planning to bench with 1 and 2 card equivs; will share numbers in doc.

alex_successops: Draft success criteria idea:
- Pilot demo passes with org stakeholders and primary use-case flows (functional sign-off)
- Latency target: p50 <300ms on Hosted with pilot load, fallback policy defined
- Data path validated end-to-end in staging (SSO, S3, API)
- Runbook + escalation path documented
- Customer satisfaction touchpoint post-demo >=7/10

priya_csm: Also flagging risk: procurement SLA for Dedicated could add 2-4 weeks if approvals delayed. Legal review of data retention could block Private deployment. We should add these to risk register now.

maya_cs: Proposed 6-week timeline (high level):
Week 0: Kickoff + discovery
Week 1: Access & infra (SSO, test keys, staging model)
Week 2: Integration work + enablement session 1
Week 3: Pilot run (limited traffic) + feedback capture
Week 4: Fixes + final demo prep
Week 5: Customer demo + go/no-go
Week 6: Handoff & success ops cadence

vellum_pm: Confirming: sample dataset (sanitized) will be under 50MB, CSV + JSON schema attached. Also intend to have legal contact available for quick Qs during week 1.

liam_se: Request: Vellum to provide IP ranges that will call staging for allowlist, and a contact for API key rotation.

jonas_eng: For Dedicated benchmark Ilaunch perf runs Tue/Wed and post results in the kickoff doc. Will need access to customer-specific model if they want exact parity.

alex_successops: Feedback plan: short NPS-lite (3 Qs) after demo + 30-min follow-up interview with primary user. Will draft survey.

priya_csm: Action owners from thread:
- maya_cs: create kickoff doc + calendar invite (owner)
- vellum_pm: upload sanitized sample + schema (owner)
- liam_se: SSO checklist + ingestion plan (owner)
- jonas_eng: Dedicated bench + smoke test template (owner)
- alex_successops: success criteria + feedback survey (owner)
- priya_csm: risk register + 30/60/90 health check invites (owner)

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Thu Oct 3 10:00am PT "Vellum Labs Onboarding Kickoff". Link: https://meet.redwood/example-link

maya_cs: Ilinked a skeleton doc in the invite with owners and pre-reads. Please add notes before the meeting.

liam_se: Note: infra team requests 48h lead for allowlist changes. Adding to calendar invite as constraint.

vellum_pm: We'll aim to upload sample by Tue EOD and confirm legal point-of-contact.

priya_csm: Thanks everyone. If any procurement/legal constraints arise, call them out here so we can adjust the plan. See you Thu.
